map.所需功率 P=负载功率÷(效率/100)；转矩 T=9550×P/n（P kW、: Required power P = load power ÷ (efficiency/100); Torque T=9550×P/n (P kW, n rpm, T N·m); match the IEC standard power series (0.75/1.1/1.5/2.2/3/4/5.5/7.5/11…) to the first rating ≥P; margin=(standard power−P)/P×100%.

map.为什么要向上取标准功率？: Why step up to a standard power?
